headline: IFB 7 kg front-load washing machine discounted by 23% to Rs 27,990 in Big Billion Days sale
hook: Discounted appliance prices during festive sales
summary: IFB Industries' 7 kg front-load washing machine with Wi-Fi is being offered at a 23% discount during the Big Billion Days sale, priced at Rs 27,990. Promotional discounts during major e-commerce sales typically drive consumer durable volumes for home appliance manufacturers. For Indian retail investors, festive sales trends provide a read on consumer demand and inventory clearance for domestic appliance brands.
why_it_matters: Festive sales gauge consumer durable demand for appliance makers.
winners_losers: Consumers gain / Appliance margins under short-term pressure
